themes: Spending before it is too late
summary_for_children: Al-Munafiqun means The Hypocrites. It warns against saying one thing and meaning another, and tells us to spend from what we have before it is too late.
environment_concept: Baskets of harvest to share before the time runs out (63:10).
architecture_and_scenery: Orchards, baskets, a timeline of seasons.

activities.name: Share now
activities.description: Carry four baskets to share now.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (baskets, orchard, village) with 1 hands-on activity in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.visual_theme: A village of winding lanes in the late afternoon with a well, a pen, a bakery stall and lanterns on posts

primary_mechanic.text: Lanterns light one at a time where someone needs a hand and burn down over 40 seconds; reach each while lit and help. Late arrivals find it out and that chance has passed (63:10); four must be taken.

unique_world.narrative_structure: A reading at the edge of the village, the lanterns, then a reading in the lane
world_assets: lanterns on posts that burn down
village lanes, well, pen, bakery stall
environment_behaviour: the lit lantern’s flame shrinks as time passes
a green light marks each chance taken
unique_world.learning_objective: Know to give now, before it is too late (63:10)

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: What Is in Our Hearts?
story_library.children_narration: Sometimes people say one thing but act differently. Surah Al-Munafiqun warns against hypocrisy and reminds us not to become so distracted by wealth or family responsibilities that we forget what matters.

world_idea.title: The House of Sincerity
world_idea.description: Explore age-appropriate fictional situations where children compare promises with actions and learn about being trustworthy.
